description: Our journey began in the Greater Philadelphia Area. The founder, Thomas, alongside his team of former D1 athletes, transitioned from the baseball field to the business sector with a unique combination of discipline, teamwork, and competitive drive.

Founded in 2020, L&M Services LLP aims to bring the same attention to detail to cleaning your home as we did on the diamond. We take immense pride in providing top-notch service to our valued customers.

Our team's dedication to a strong work ethic and strategic mindset sets us apart in the residential and commercial exterior cleaning industry. Whether you need power washing, soft washing, or gutter cleaning, you can trust us to deliver unparalleled service from start to finish.

L&M Services LLP offers a comprehensive range of services to meet your exterior cleaning needs. From power washing and soft washing to gutter cleaning and window washing, our experienced team ensures top-quality results.

We specialize in safe soft washing techniques for delicate surfaces and high-pressure power washing for durable surfaces. Additionally, we provide roof cleaning, siding washing, and concrete cleaning to enhance your property's curb appeal.

section.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
section.description: Expert answers to common questions about power washing, soft washing, gutter cleaning, and our services.

items.question: What is the difference between soft washing and power washing?
items.answer: Soft washing uses low-pressure water combined with specialized cleaning solutions to safely remove mold, algae, and dirt from delicate surfaces like siding and roofs. Power washing uses high-pressure water to clean durable surfaces such as concrete, driveways, and patios. Choosing the right method protects your property while delivering the best results.

items.question: Is soft washing safe for my home's siding and roof?
items.answer: Yes! Soft washing is the safest method for cleaning siding, roofs, and other delicate exterior surfaces. The low-pressure application combined with biodegradable cleaning solutions effectively removes organic growth without risking damage that high-pressure washing could cause.

items.question: How often should I have my house washed in King of Prussia, PA?
items.answer: In the Greater Philadelphia area, we generally recommend having your home's exterior professionally cleaned once per year. However, properties with significant tree coverage, high humidity exposure, or visible mold and algae growth may benefit from more frequent cleanings. We can assess your property and recommend the ideal schedule.

items.question: What surfaces can you power wash?
items.answer: We can power wash durable surfaces including concrete driveways, sidewalks, patios, brick walls, stone walkways, and garage floors. These hard surfaces can withstand high-pressure cleaning and benefit greatly from the deep clean it provides.

items.question: How much does house washing or power washing cost?
items.answer: Pricing varies based on the size of your property, the surfaces being cleaned, and the methods required. That's why we offer free, no-obligation estimates. Contact us at 215-346-6027 or estimate@l-mservices.com and we'll provide a transparent quote tailored to your specific needs.

items.question: Why are there black streaks on my roof or siding?
items.answer: Black streaks on your roof are typically caused by a type of algae called Gloeocapsa magma. On siding, dark stains often come from mold, mildew, or dirt accumulation. Our soft washing treatments effectively eliminate these unsightly streaks and help prevent them from returning.

items.question: How long do the results of soft washing last?
items.answer: With our professional soft washing treatments, results typically last 12-18 months depending on environmental conditions. We use high-quality cleaning solutions that not only remove organic growth but also inhibit regrowth for longer-lasting results.

items.question: Do you offer gutter cleaning services?
items.answer: Yes! Gutter cleaning is one of our core services. We thoroughly remove debris from gutters and downspouts, ensuring proper water flow. We also offer gutter brightening to improve the exterior appearance of your gutter system.

items.question: Do you clean both interior and exterior windows?
items.answer: Yes! We offer professional window cleaning for both interior and exterior windows. Our streak-free results will leave your windows crystal clear, enhancing your home's natural light and overall curb appeal.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Absolutely. L&M Services LLP is fully licensed and insured for your protection and peace of mind. We take our professional responsibilities seriously and ensure every job is completed safely and to the highest standard.
